mcqs.question: The rate-limiting and committed regulatory enzyme of glycolysis is:
mcqs.explanation: PFK-1 catalyzes the irreversible phosphorylation of fructose-6-phosphate to fructose-1,6-bisphosphate, allosterically activated by AMP and fructose-2,6-bisphosphate.
mcqs.subject: Biochemistry

mcqs.question: Which inborn error of metabolism is caused by a deficiency of the enzyme homogentisate 1,2-dioxygenase?
mcqs.explanation: Alkaptonuria results from homogentisate oxidase deficiency, causing accumulation of homogentisic acid, black urine on standing, and ochronotic arthritis.
mcqs.subject: Biochemistry
